edition: ADR 2025 ECE/TRANS/352 Vol. I; MTC Rev8 and Amend1
description: Unsupported-case, legal prohibition, exception and human-review register. All entries must be passed to integrator; no global non-dangerous output.

items.case_description: self-reactive Type A
items.required_action: No packaging permission or UN assignment

items.case_description: self-reactive Type G
items.required_action: Check other transport hazards; oxidizing mixture Note 2 routes to 5.1

items.case_description: self-reactive unlisted substance/formulation without origin-country approval
items.required_action: Competent-authority classification/test report and carriage conditions required

items.case_description: listed self-reactive different concentration, activator or formulation
items.required_action: Re-evaluate type, SADT, packing and authorizations; cannot reuse list row blindly

items.case_description: self-reactive sample with incomplete test series
items.required_action: OP2, <=10 kg/transport unit, no more danger than type B and temperature data required

items.case_description: self-reactive diluent causing concentration on leakage or incompatibility
items.required_action: Full diluent/stability checks; numeric checks on liquid temperature-controlled diluent

items.case_description: missing offered-package SADT, 50 kg SADT or decomposition calorimetry
items.required_action: Do not treat absent SADT as high/low; no automatic temperature-control release

items.case_description: oxidizing mixture with >=5% combustible organic
items.required_action: Type B–F Class 4.1 vs Type G consideration for 5.1; integrator precedence

items.case_description: solid desensitized explosive absent Table A entry
items.required_action: No invented n.o.s. UN assignment

items.case_description: frictional ignition material without verified named-entry analogy/SP
items.required_action: No generic N.1 PG algorithm for friction

items.case_description: metal powders liable to spontaneous combustion or water-reactive gas emission
items.required_action: Route to Class 4.2/4.3 specialists; resolve precedence

items.case_description: inorganic flammable substance in molten form, not sulphur molten
items.required_action: Named exception UN2448 must be verified, not guessed

items.case_description: phosphorus sulphides contaminated with yellow/white phosphorus
items.required_action: No transport acceptance

items.case_description: flammable solid oxidizing UN3097 without Class 1 requirement verification
items.required_action: Class 1 requirements and multiple hazard route require review

items.case_description: chemically unstable material with dangerous reaction not prevented in carriage
items.required_action: Stabilization and contamination review mandatory

items.case_description: polymerizing material meeting another class 1–8 criterion
items.required_action: Do not automatically allocate 4.1; SP386 and integrator

items.case_description: SAPT missing or not measured for actual container/as-offered state
items.required_action: Separate packaging/IBC <=50C and tank <=45C

items.case_description: nonmetal positive rate criterion without under-45-second time/wetted-zone result
items.required_action: Cannot infer PG from >2.2 mm/s alone

items.case_description: contradictory preliminary N.1 and full-burning test evidence
items.required_action: Require original test report/method review

items.case_description: substance named in Table A claimed to be nonflammable via tests
items.required_action: Exact named entry, evidence and reviewer decision, no automatic named-entry override

items.case_description: physically untestable or inapplicable N.1 sample
items.required_action: Analogy and special provisions; do not fabricate burn time

items.case_description: MTC Rev8 Amendment1 Appendix6 calorimetric screening used to exclude self-reactivity
items.required_action: Fresh/aged samples and autocatalytic limitations; requires expert assessment

items.case_description: unresolved ADR 2025 corrigenda or Table A discrepancies
items.required_action: No independent reconciliation of text, row IDs and special provisions

items.case_description: PG candidate conflicts with verified Table A column 4 or named-entry conditions
items.required_action: Final PG blocked pending table row and special provision reconciliation

items.case_description: unverified CLP/GHS label or missing negative evidence
items.required_action: CLP/GHS not a transport evidence substitute

items.case_description: other listed self-reactive IBC/tank temperature/control/emergency conditions
items.required_action: Need authoritative list, transport mode, detailed quantity and temperature conditions
